coverage.culture_version_source: verified frozen manifest, not package-latest inference

allocation.authority: Root-owned overall execution ledger; creative session.json is only the pilot journal and must not reset or replace overall counters.
allocation.units: Logical admitted tasks/actions, not internal inference, tokens, billing, or every browser RPC. A bounded batch lists subactions; failed or partial reserved units remain consumed.

rows.scope: Isolation/condition freezing, implementation, targeted contracts/package checks, journal preparation and final root rollup.
One fresh isolated decision task per frozen case on control guidance.
One fresh isolated decision task per identical case on the frozen candidate guidance.
Deux tâches natives bornées de proposition/revue de code, autorisées par la demande utilisateur ; root reste seul à écrire/appliquer les changements produit. Aucun slot de retry ou meta-test.
Real research, Threading export, two directions, actual inspection/choice and bounded selected correction or final critique.
Root exact-label control and byte proof; no model or creative activity needed.

PV1_model_tasks.purpose: Research synthesis from actually inspected supports and cultural rebounds.
Realize direction PV1-D1 after research acceptance and native asset availability.
Realize structurally distinct direction PV1-D2 under the same approved brief.
At most one selected model-assisted correction, or final bounded critique if no correction is requested.

allocation.correction_limit_note: Two rounds is a protocol ceiling, not an entitlement. This allocation supports at most one extra model-assisted correction task. Further model tasks or a full third five-case cohort require a revised plan and fresh required approvals.
allocation.admission_rule: Before every operation, root checks remaining overall allocation, the phase/pilot allocation and the creative journal ceiling; admission requires all three to permit the operation. The pilot journal alone never proves global compliance.
allocation.unspent_units: Remain unused unless a root-recorded reallocation stays within approved scopes and all original global/per-resource ceilings; no automatic expansion.

native_code_support_tasks.purpose: Proposition ciblée de driver/adaptation Threading à partir des seuls extraits nécessaires ; aucun outil média, effet produit ou écriture produit par le sous-agent.
Proposition ou revue ciblée du contrat culturel/protocole 1.1 à partir des extraits nécessaires ; root vérifie et applique.

allocation.replay_failure_rule: Aucun retry automatique ni slot de meta-test. Une preuve manquante, INVALID ou régression qui exige de nouvelles tâches/full replay arrête la qualification et impose révision du plan et approvals requis avant tout appel supplémentaire.

profile_qualification.paired_pressure_profile: One exact declared tuple for all five BASELINE and all five RETEST tasks. Any new model/version/reasoning profile needs its own complete paired corpus and a revised allocation.
profile_qualification.unknown_fields: Keep null; never fill from a family name, alias, requested model, parent session or guessed version.
profile_qualification.diagnostic_exception: No exception inherited. If immutable identity remains unavailable, root must propose a fresh hash-bound diagnostic-only exception in this run for explicit Gate 3 approval; results stay diagnostic and promotion_eligible false.

ownership_and_errors.overall_ledger: Prepared at Stage 04 start before any execution model/tool task; root records all execution consumption, including implementation, cohorts and pilot.
ownership_and_errors.creative_journal: Prepare only after candidate condition is frozen and all this run’s Gate 1/2/3 bindings hold; session.json owns pilot reservations/receipts, with brief state files as projections.
ownership_and_errors.pending: At most one creative reservation pending; save exact request before admission and seal returned artifacts in its receipt.
ownership_and_errors.uncertain: Preserve operation/attempt identity and actual outcome; never replay uncertain request bytes automatically.
ownership_and_errors.blocked_or_budget_exhausted: Preserve partial/non-observed state and receipts; do not invent culture, user choice, export or render to finalize.
ownership_and_errors.amendments: No parent amendments apply and no budget increase is approved by this policy.
ownership_and_errors.determinism: No universal claim; fixed-environment repeatability only if actually observed, otherwise preserve output and hash.
